blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: 现有的视觉语言模型(VLMs)对于精细的视觉感知仍然不可靠. 在本报告中,我们介绍了WeVisOne-VL(WeChat Vision All-in-One),这是一种强大的VLM,通过结构化的下台预测,统一对象级别和像素级别感知. 它支持多个视觉任务,包括对象检测,转介本地化,计数,OCR,分区化,以及交配,使得任何用户特定颗粒的本地化,从点和盒到面具和α垫. 在建筑上,我们通过一个特殊的<OBJ>令牌,将一个轻量级像素解码器整合到VLM中,以生成实例级像素输出. 我们用三个阶段的课程来训练这个模型 SFT 然后是混合任务RL 在超过30个基准中,WeVisOne-VL在对象级别和像素级别的任务上都显示出领先的性能,同时对对象偏差查询保持强烈拒绝. 通过将WeVisOne-VL释放给开源社区,我们希望将VLM从广义的视觉理解推进到真正可靠的感知系统,用于现实世界的部署.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Perceiving and understanding the visual world has long been a central pursuit of computer vision [ 46 , 25 , 70 , 32 , 5 , 45 , 1 , 94 ] . An intelligent visual system must be able to recognize what is present in an image, identify which object a user is referring to, and determine where these objects exist. Such capabilities establish the foundation for a wide range of real-world applications, such as content creation [ 65 ] , industrial inspection [ 37 ] , autonomous driving, and embodied intelligence [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 认识和理解视觉世界长期以来一直是对计算机视觉的一种中心追求[46,25,70,32,5,45,1,94]. 智能视觉系统必须能够识别图像中存在的内容,识别用户指的是哪一个对象,并确定这些对象是否存在. 这种能力为广泛的现实世界应用奠定了基础,例如内容创建[65],工业检查[37],自主驾驶,以及体现智慧[18]。

blocks.en: Over the past decade, computer vision has made remarkable progress toward this goal. From conventional detection and segmentation models (e.g., YOLO [ 86 ] and DETR [ 5 ] ), to open-world perception models (e.g., Grounding-DINO [ 67 ] and SAM [ 45 ] ), and more recently to large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) [ 1 ] , this field is being driven toward more unified, general, and powerful visual systems. This evolution has substantially broadened the concepts that a model can recognize and the instructions that it can follow. However, when both performance and efficiency are considered, current models are still far from satisfactory for real-world deployment. They often hallucinate non-existent objects, misinterpret user intent when encountering unfamiliar object descriptions, or overlook non-salient instances, leading to incomplete recall.
blocks.zh: 在过去十年中,计算机愿景在实现这一目标方面取得了显著进展。 从常规的探测和分区模型(如YOLO[86]和DETR[5]),到开放世界的感知模型(如Grounding-DINO[67]和SAM[45]),以及最近到大型Visual-Language Models[1],这个领域正被推向更加统一,通用,强大的视觉系统. 这种演变大大拓宽了一个模型能够承认的概念和它能够遵循的指示. 然而,在考虑业绩和效率时,目前的模式对于实际世界的部署仍然远远不能令人满意。 他们常常幻觉不存在的物体,在遇到不熟悉的物体描述时误解用户的用意,或者忽略非偏好的情况,导致不完全的召回.

blocks.en:
In this report, we introduce WeVisOne-VL ( We Chat Vis ion All-in- One ), a frontier vision-language model that unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception through a single natural-language interface. The model casts diverse visual tasks as structured next-token prediction and incorporates a lightweight pixel decoder for generating dense outputs.
Built on Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] , we instantiate our models at two scales: 2B and 4B. We train the models on approximately 100M images with fine-grain annotations using a multi-stage curriculum. The key designs of WeVisOne-VL are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh:
在本报告中,我们引入了We VisOne-VL(We Chat Vis ion All-in-One),这是一种前沿视觉语言模型,通过单一的自然语言界面统一对象水平和像素水平的视觉感知. 该模型投射了多种视觉任务,作为结构化的次托肯预测,并包含一个轻量级像素解码器,用于生成密集输出.
建于Qwen3-VL [1]上,我们以2B和4B两个尺度即时化我们的模型. 我们使用一个多阶段的课程,对大约100M图像的模型进行精细说明的培训。 WeVisOne-VL的关键设计概括如下.

blocks.en: Data Engine. We develop a unified data engine that connects semantic discovery with instance-aligned supervision for object detection, referring localization, segmentation, and matting. To guide targeted acquisition and task-specific annotation, the engine organizes category concepts and compositional referring expressions in a shared knowledge graph. It then combines complementary localization experts to generate spatial candidates and consolidates their predictions through visual-language verification of query–instance correspondence. Building on these verified localizations, the engine generates binary masks to extend supervision to the pixel level while preserving target identity across tasks, with manual spot checks for additional quality control. For matting, it further leverages expert predictions and curated data to support a dedicated annotator that provides continuous alpha supervision. Finally, the engine uses reviewed model errors to guide subsequent acquisition, annotation correction, and hard-example sampling, enabling iterative refinement of the training data.
blocks.zh: 数据引擎. 我们开发了一个统一的数据引擎,将语义学发现与实例对齐的监管连接起来,用于物体检测,参考本地化,分化,和交配. 为了指导有目标的获取和针对特定任务的注释,该引擎在共享知识图中组织分类概念和成分参考表达. 然后,它结合了互补的本地化专家来产生空间候选人,并通过视觉语言验证查询-信息通信来巩固他们的预测. 在这些经过核实的本地化的基础上,引擎生成二进制口罩,以将监管延伸到像素级别,同时在任务之间保留目标身份,并进行人工抽查以进行额外的质量控制. 对于搭配,它进一步利用专家的预测和整理数据来支持一个提供连续α监督的专用注释器. 最后,该引擎使用经过审查的模型错误来指导随后的获取,注释校正,以及硬样本采样,从而能够迭代完善培训数据.

blocks.en: Model Design. WeVisOne-VL consists of a VLM backbone and a lightweight pixel decoder. Built on Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] , WeVisOne-VL casts a broad range of vision tasks as structured next-token prediction, generating object labels and spatial coordinates autoregressively. For compact and efficient output, we introduce a group of dedicated tokens (from <0> to <1000> ) to encode normalized coordinates [ 40 ] . For dense prediction tasks, the model generates a special <OBJ> token after each predicted bounding box, whose hidden state serves as a latent representation of the corresponding instance. The pixel decoder combines this instance representation with multi-level features from the shared ViT to produce predictions over the full image canvas. In this way, WeVisOne-VL supports both discrete and dense predictions without relying on a separate large segmentation model [ 48 , 122 , 68 , 61 ] .
blocks.zh: 型号设计. We VisOne-VL由一个VLM主干线和一个轻量级像素解码器组成. 建于Quen3-VL [1] 上,WeVisOne-VL以结构化的下台预测,自动生成物体标签和空间坐标的方式,投放了一系列广泛的视野任务. 对于紧凑高效的输出,我们引入一组专用符号(从<0>到<1000>),以编码正常化坐标[40]. 对于密集的预测任务,模型在每个预测的边框后产生一个特殊的"OBJ"符号,其隐藏状态是对应实例的潜在代表. 像素解码器将这个实例代表与共享的ViT的多层特征结合起来,在全图像画布上产生预测. 这样,WeVisOne-VL支持离散和密密的预测,而不依赖单独的大分解模型[48,122,68,61].

blocks.en: Training Pipeline. We train WeVisOne-VL in a curriculum pipeline consisting of three-stage Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by mixed-task Reinforcement Learning (RL). Stage 1 establishes task alignment, teaching the model to follow task instructions and produce well-formed structured outputs. Stage 2 introduces high-resolution and dense perception data to improve the recall of small and crowded objects. Stage 3 further incorporates pixel-level tasks, extending the model from discrete localization to dense prediction. For RL, we first select samples on which the SFT model is most uncertain, then apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) over the mixture of tasks. This on-policy optimization effectively improves the localization accuracy, while suppressing repeated or hallucinated predictions.
blocks.zh: 训导管道. 我们把WeVisOne-VL培训成一个课程管道,由三阶段监督精选(SFT),然后是混合任务强化学习(RL)。 第1阶段建立任务协调,教导该模式遵循任务指示,并产生结构完善的结构化产出. 第二阶段引入高分辨率和密集感知数据,以改善小型和拥挤物体的召回。 第3阶段进一步包含了像素级任务,将模型从离散局部化扩展到密集预测. 对于RL,我们首先选择SFT模型最不确定的样本,然后在任务组合上应用Group相对政策优化(GPRO). 这种政策优化有效地提高了本地化的准确性,同时抑制了重复的或幻觉的预测.

blocks.en: Across multiple visual benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates highly competitive performance against both state-of-the-art general-purpose models and specialized vision systems. It exhibits consistently strong capabilities on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, including object detection, fine-grained referring, text recognition and language-guided pixel prediction. In addition, it also shows strong potential in challenging real-world scenarios, such as maintaining high recall in crowded scenes and correctly rejecting queries when the target is absent. By unifying these capabilities into a single model, we offer a powerful, efficient, and versatile vision-language foundation for the open-source community, accelerating the development of truly practical and reliable visual systems.
blocks.zh: 通过多种视觉基准,We VisOne-VL显示,相对于最先进的通用模型和专门视觉系统,其性能具有高度竞争力。 它在对象级和像素级的任务上都表现出一贯的强大能力,包括物体检测,精细的参考,文本识别和语言导导的像素预测. 此外,它还显示出挑战现实世界情景的强大潜力,例如在拥挤的场景中保持高召回,在目标缺席时正确拒绝询问. 通过将这些能力统一为一个单一模式,我们为开源社区提供了强大,高效,多功能的视觉语言基础,加速了真正实用,可靠的视觉系统的发展.

blocks.en: 2 WeVisOne-VL Data Engine
blocks.zh: 2个VisOne-VL 数据引擎

blocks.en: Data construction for unified visual perception must support both category-level recognition and context-dependent target selection, while preserving instance associations across language and spatial supervision. To this end, we build the WeVisOne-VL Data Engine (WDE). WDE draws on GRIT [ 78 ] , CC3M [ 90 ] , LAION [ 49 ] , SA-1B [ 45 ] , and several task-specific datasets, and its annotation inventory comprises over 100 million images and approximately 3.6 billion bounding-box annotations.
blocks.zh: 用于统一视觉感知的数据构建必须支持类别级别的识别和基于背景的目标选择,同时保留跨语言和空间监督的实例关联。 为此,我们建造了WeVisOne-VL数据引擎(WDE). WDE借鉴了GRIT [78],CC3M [90],LAION [49],SA-1B [45],以及一些特定任务数据集,其注释清单包含超过1亿张图像和约36亿边框说明.

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows an overview of WDE. We first organize category concepts and referring expressions in a shared knowledge graph, which guides targeted image acquisition (Section 2.1 ). The acquired image–query pairs then go through task-specific localization and semantic verification, which establish the correspondence between each query and its target instances (Sections 2.2 and 2.3 ). We keep these correspondences when generating binary masks (Section 2.4 ), and further extend the instance annotations to continuous alpha supervision with a dedicated matting pipeline (Section 2.6 ). Finally, model errors reviewed after each training round guide subsequent acquisition and annotation refinement (Section 2.7 ). Below, we describe each component in detail.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了WDE的概况. 我们首先在共同的知识图中组织分类概念和提及表达方式,指导有针对性地获取图像(第2.1节)。 获得的图像-query配对然后通过特定任务本地化和语义验证,确定每个查询与目标实例之间的对应(第2.2和2.3节)。 在生成二进制口罩时,我们保留这些信件(第2.4节),并进一步将实例说明扩大到连续的α监督,并配有专用的交配管道(第2.6节)。 最后,在每轮培训之后,对模型错误进行审查,指导随后的获取和注释的改进(第2.7节)。 下面我们详细描述每个组成部分。

blocks.zh: 图2:WeVisOne-VL数据引擎(WDE)概览.

blocks.en: 2.1 Concept Discovery and Targeted Acquisition
blocks.zh: 2.1 概念发现和定向获取

blocks.en: Semantic discovery produces two complementary annotations: category-level concepts and compositional referring expressions. For detection, we use an optimized Tokenize Anything model [ 76 ] to discover object categories. For referring tasks, we prompt Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] to generate referring expressions that specify targets through attributes, states, actions, and relations. Category concepts support category-based localization, while referring expressions support selecting particular instances from their context. Both serve as annotation queries, and their correspondence to image regions is established in the subsequent localization stages.
blocks.zh: 语义发现产生了两个补充说明:类别级概念和组成式的参考表达式. 为了检测,我们使用一个优化的Tokenize Anything模型[76]来发现对象类别. 对于引用任务,我们提示 Qune3-VL [1] 生成通过属性,状态,动作和关系来指定目标的引用表达式. 类别概念支持基于类别本地化,同时引用表达式支持从上下文中选择特定实例. 两者都作为注释查询,它们与图像区域的通信在之后的本地化阶段建立.

blocks.en: We organize both category concepts and referring expressions in a shared knowledge graph. The graph is initialized from resources including Wikipedia 1 1 1 https://www.wikipedia.org/ and WordNet [ 73 ] , and represents canonical category names, aliases, taxonomic relations, and whole–part relations. A candidate term is first linked to existing nodes through text retrieval and vision-language verification, and is considered for addition to the graph only when it is supported by stable visual evidence. During normalization, we merge equivalent category terms while keeping the descriptive constraints that determine the scope of referring expressions.
blocks.zh: 我们用共同的知识图来组织分类概念和提及表达方式。 该图由维基百科11 1 https://www.wikipedia.org/和WordNet[73]等资源初始化,并代表了犬类名称,别名,分类关系,以及整段关系. 候选名词首先通过文本检索和视觉语言验证与现有的节点相连,只有在有稳定的视觉证据支持的情况下,才考虑加入图表. 在正常化期间,我们合并了等同的类别术语,同时保留决定提及表达范围的说明性限制。

blocks.en: This semantic organization also supports targeted acquisition. Concept names and aliases serve as textual retrieval queries, verified instances provide visual retrieval cues, and historical errors indicate where additional coverage is needed. We set sampling priorities according to concept representation, image domain, target scale, and challenging conditions such as occlusion and dense object arrangements, and confusable categories and recurring failures in interpreting referring expressions further inform acquisition. In this way, annotation effort is directed toward both semantic gaps and visual conditions that remain difficult for the current model. The acquired image–query pairs are then sent to the detection or referring annotation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 这个语义组织也支持定向收购. 概念名称和别名可作为文字检索查询,经核实的实例提供视觉检索提示,历史错误表明需要增加覆盖面。 我们根据概念表达、图像域、目标规模以及隐蔽和密集对象安排等具有挑战性的条件,以及可混淆的类别和在解释引用表达方式时一再出现故障,设定了取样优先事项,进一步为获取提供信息。 这样,注解努力既针对语义差距,也针对目前模式仍然困难的视觉条件. 然后将获得的图像-query配对发送到检测或参考注释管道。

blocks.en: 2.2 Detection Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.2 检测说明

blocks.en: Conventional object detectors excel at detecting densely distributed objects but struggle to recognize long-tail categories and open-world concepts. By contrast, VLMs offer strong recognition capabilities but often exhibit low recall in dense object scenarios. Therefore, for each object category, we first utilize detectors to generate exhaustive proposals, and then use a VLM for post verification. Specifically, we obtain proposals in parallel from SAM3 [ 4 ] and an in-house open-vocabulary detector based on a DINO-style architecture [ 123 ] , which we refine iteratively. For each image–query pair, the predictions of both models are merged into a shared candidate pool. This design reduces our reliance on any single proposal source and uses the variation across detectors to pursue broader instance coverage.
blocks.zh: 常规物体探测器擅长探测分布密集的物体,但努力识别长尾类和开放世界的概念。 相比之下,VLMs提供了强大的识别能力,但在密集的物体情景中却往往表现出较低的召回能力. 因此,对于每个对象类别,我们首先利用探测器提出详尽的建议,然后使用甚高频进行事后核查。 具体地说,我们从SAM3[4]和基于DINO式建筑的内置开放式伏车探测器获得平行的建议[123],我们反复加以改进。 对于每个图像-query对子,两个模型的预测被合并为一个共享的候选集合. 这一设计减少了我们对任何单一提案来源的依赖,并利用各种探测器的变异来扩大实例覆盖面。

blocks.en: For detection, we obtain proposals in parallel from two models: SAM3 [ 4 ] and an in-house open-vocabulary detector based on a DINO-style architecture [ 123 ] , which we refine iteratively. For each image–query pair, the predictions of both models are merged into a shared candidate pool. This design reduces our reliance on any single proposal source and uses the variation across detectors to pursue broader instance coverage.
blocks.zh: 为了探测,我们从两个模型中平行地获得建议:SAM3[4]和一个基于DINO式建筑[123]的内部开放式伏波探测器,我们反复地加以改进。 对于每个图像-query对子,两个模型的预测被合并为一个共享的候选集合. 这一设计减少了我们对任何单一提案来源的依赖,并利用各种探测器的变异来扩大实例覆盖面。

blocks.en: We then use Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] to verify whether each proposed region matches the category query given the image content. Based on its judgments, we select candidates, remove duplicates, and resolve conflicting predictions. For the retained instances, we keep the bounding boxes produced by the localization models. These boxes serve as detection supervision and also define the target instances used in the subsequent segmentation annotation.
blocks.zh: 然后我们使用 Quen3-VL [1] 来验证每个拟议区域是否匹配给图像内容的类别查询 。 根据其判断,我们挑选候选人,消除重复,解决相互矛盾的预测。 对于保留的例子,我们保留由本地化模型产生的边框。 这些盒子充当检测监督,并定义了后续分区注释中使用的目标实例.

blocks.en: 2.3 Referring Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.3 参考说明

blocks.en: Referring annotation requires the predicted regions to satisfy the compositional meaning of an expression, including the conditions that distinguish the intended targets within a scene. We build this stage on the SAM3 Agent framework [ 4 ] and add Rex-Omni [ 40 ] as an additional localization expert. Within the same expression-conditioned workflow, SAM3 and Rex-Omni both propose candidate regions, providing complementary localization evidence for the same expression.
blocks.zh: 提及注释需要预测的区域满足一个表达的构成意义,包括区分场景中预定目标的条件. 我们在SAM3代理框架[4]上建造这个阶段,并增加Rex-Omni[40]作为额外的本地化专家. 在相同表达条件的工作流程中,SAM3和Rex-Omni都提出了候选区域,为同一表达提供了互补的本地化证据.

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL then consolidates these proposals by checking whether each one matches the expression in its image context. The check covers the attributes, states, actions, and relations stated in the expression, and distinguishes the requested targets from objects that are mentioned only as contextual references. Whether an expression refers to a whole object or one of its parts is likewise determined by the expression itself. Conflicting proposals are resolved through the same semantic check. The accepted results bind each expression to an individual target or a target set, so that the annotation preserves the selection constraints of the query.
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL然后通过检查每个在图像上下文中是否匹配表达式来整合这些提议. 检查涵盖了表达式中描述的属性,状态,动作和关系,并将所请求的目标与仅作为上下文引用的对象区分开来. 表达式是指整个对象还是其一部分,同样是由表达式本身决定的. 相互矛盾的建议通过同样的语义检查来解决. 被接受的结果将每个表达式绑定在单个目标或目标集上,这样注释就可以保留查询的选择限制.

blocks.en: 2.4 Mask Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.4 面具注释

blocks.en: For each localized instance, we use SAM2 [ 85 ] to predict a binary mask of its visible region. Each mask inherits the query of the box it is generated from. Each instance thus has both a box and a mask under the same query. With category queries, the boxes supervise detection and the masks supervise category-conditioned segmentation. With referring expressions, the boxes supervise referring localization and the masks supervise referring segmentation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个本地化的例子,我们使用SAM2[85]来预测其可见区域的二进制面具. 每个掩码继承其生成的框的查询. 因此,每个实例都在同一查询下有一个盒子和一个面具。 通过分类查询,盒子监督检测,口罩监督有类别条件的分区. 在引用表达式中,框监督引用本地化,口罩监督引用分区。

blocks.en: We manually spot-check a subset of these annotations, checking whether each mask and box are linked to the correct instance and whether the masks are accurate. Defects found in this check are corrected through the refinement process in Section 2.7 . We also record the source of every annotation, so that affected labels can be traced and regenerated.
blocks.zh: 我们手动抽查这些说明的一个子集,检查每个口罩和盒子是否与正确的实例相连,口罩是否准确. 本检查中发现的缺陷,通过2.7节的完善过程予以纠正. 我们还记录每个注释的来源,这样受影响的标签就可以被追踪和再生成.

blocks.en: 2.5 Hard-Example Construction
blocks.zh: 2.5 硬建筑实例

blocks.en: Some distinctions may not be adequately represented by broad semantic coverage alone, and we construct hard examples to focus on them. Candidate queries are derived from confusable concepts in the knowledge graph, visually similar categories, controlled changes to descriptive conditions, and observed model failures. These sources provide plausible alternatives that can only be handled by precisely interpreting both the category and the contextual constraints of a query.
blocks.zh: 仅凭广义的语义涵盖可能不足以体现某些区别,我们树立了以这些区别为重点的硬例子。 候选查询来源于知识图中的可混淆概念,视觉相似的类别,对描述条件的控制变化,以及观察到的模型故障. 这些来源提供了可行的替代办法,只能通过准确解释查询的类别和背景限制来处理。

blocks.en: A query is negative only when no object in the image satisfies all of its conditions, and this cannot be decided from the query or the detector output alone. For example, changing “red car” to “blue car” does not mean the image contains no blue car, and a detector that returns nothing for a query may simply have missed the target. Therefore, we review each candidate negative against the whole image, checking the attributes, actions, and relations in the query. If a matching target turns out to exist, the query is sent back to positive annotation.
blocks.zh: 只有当图像中没有一个对象满足其所有条件时,查询才为负数,这不能单从查询或检测器输出中决定. 例如,将“红色汽车”改为“蓝色汽车”并不意味着图像中没有蓝色汽车,而且一个不返回任何查询的探测器可能只是错过了目标。 因此,我们对照整个图像对每个候选人进行负面审查,检查查询中的属性、行动和关系。 如果匹配的目标最终存在,则将查询发回正注释.

blocks.en: Whether an example is hard is determined by the behavior of the current model. A reviewed negative becomes a hard negative when the model nevertheless predicts a target region for it. Such examples carry an empty target set, so they teach the model to reject the query without introducing any box or pixel targets. We retain the erroneous predictions as evidence of the underlying confusion. Hard positives, in turn, capture missed targets, incorrect referent selection, and difficult localization under crowding or occlusion. We keep their reliable annotations, so that these examples strengthen the model’s sensitivity to true targets while hard negatives teach it to reject. Sample difficulty is reassessed for each model version, and the sampling emphasis is adjusted toward persistent and newly emerging failure modes.
blocks.zh: 实例是否难由当前模型的行为决定. 如果模型对目标区域作出预测,经过审查的负数就变成硬负数。 这类例子带有一个空目标集,因此它们教模型拒绝查询而不引入任何框或像素目标. 我们保留错误的预测,以证明潜在的混乱。 硬阳性反之,捕捉错失目标,不正确的参考选择,以及拥挤或隔离下难以本地化. 我们保留他们可靠的说明,以便这些例子能够加强模型对真正目标的敏感性,而硬反面则教它拒绝。 对每个模型版本的样本难度进行重新评估,并调整样本重点,使之适应持久性和新出现的故障模式。

blocks.en: 2.6 Matting Data Engine
blocks.zh: 2.6 装配数据引擎

blocks.en: We build a dedicated matting pipeline within WDE to provide WeVisOne-VL with alpha supervision across the diverse objects and scenes in our instance corpus. On the one hand, high-quality matting annotations are expensive to acquire, which limits their scale and coverage. Compositing foregrounds onto new backgrounds can enlarge the training set, but mismatched lighting and unnatural boundary transitions limit how well models trained on these images generalize to real scenes [ 55 , 115 ] . On the other hand, our instance annotations already identify each target and its spatial extent, but their binary masks lack the continuous alpha values needed for detailed boundary supervision [ 115 ] . Extending them to matting therefore requires recovering fine details while preserving the target specified by each description, even when the reference mask has a coarse or inaccurate boundary. To this end, we combine expert-assisted annotation, dedicated annotator training, and corpus re-annotation, producing alpha labels that remain associated with the original instance descriptions and bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们在WDE内部建造了一条专用的交配管道,为WeVisOne-VL提供α监督,覆盖我们实例中的各种物体和场景. 一方面,高质量的交配说明昂贵,限制了其规模和覆盖面。 将前景组合到新的背景可以扩大训练集,但不匹配的照明和不自然的边界过渡限制了在这些图像上训练的模型对真实场景的普遍化程度[55,115]. 另一方面,我们的例子说明已经确定了每个目标及其空间范围,但是它们的二进制面具缺乏详细边界监督所需的连续α值[115]. 因此,要将它们扩展至交配,就需要在保留每项描述规定的目标的同时,恢复精细的细节,即使参考面具有粗糙或不准确的边界。 为此,我们把专家协助的注释、专门的注释员培训以及官司的重新注释结合起来,产生仍然与原实例描述和边框有关的α标签。

blocks.en:
Matting Annotator Training. We train a dedicated matting annotator by sampling instances with initial labels and high-quality matting data in equal proportions, combining broad instance coverage with detailed alpha supervision. Inspired by SAM2Matting [ 91 ] , we adopt a frozen segmentation backbone with a trainable matting head. Specifically, we augment a frozen SAM2.1-Base+ model [ 85 ] with a new lightweight alpha refinement head. The head fuses multi-scale image features, prompt-mask guidance injected at each decoding stage, and local detail features from a shallow RGB stem, using top-down decoding to directly predict an alpha matte.
During training, prompt masks are obtained by binarizing the target alpha, taking the instance segmentation mask, randomly perturbing these masks, or segmenting the target with box-prompted SAM2. The objective combines multi-scale L 1 L_{1} and Laplacian alpha losses with foreground/background supervision and a prompt-consistency term applied only to unperturbed object-level prompts. Additional transition-region losses are applied to samples with continuous alpha labels, excluding small targets.

blocks.en: Corpus Re-annotation. Finally, we apply the trained annotator to all annotated instances in the training corpus, using the existing instance annotations to specify each target. Its predictions replace the initial labels and serve as the final alpha pseudo-labels for the matting training described in Section 4 . Since each matte remains linked to its original instance description and bounding box, language grounding and matting are supervised on the same target.

blocks.en: 2.7 Training Feedback and Data Refinement
blocks.zh: 2.7 培训反馈和数据改进

blocks.en: After each training round, we analyze model errors to guide both data acquisition and annotation refinement. We organize the errors by concept, image domain, target scale, occlusion, task, and failure type, and apply clustering and deduplication to select representative cases for review. This concentrates annotation effort on recurring failures and coverage gaps.
blocks.zh: 每轮训练结束后,我们分析模型错误,以指导数据获取和注释的完善. 我们按照概念,图像域,目标尺度,隐蔽,任务,以及故障类型来组织错误,并应用分组和调试来选择代表案例进行审查. 这集中了对反复出现的失败和覆盖面差距的注解。

blocks.en: The review distinguishes errors in model prediction from errors in supervision. If the annotation is reliable, we keep the example unchanged; it may receive greater sampling emphasis or serve as a retrieval seed for related images. If the review identifies an annotation defect, we correct or regenerate the affected supervision before including it in a subsequent data version. In other words, model disagreement only triggers an investigation, and annotations are changed only after review.
blocks.zh: 审查将模型预测错误与监督错误区分开来. 如果注解是可靠的,我们保留这个例子不变;它可能会得到更多的抽样强调,或者作为相关图像的检索种子. 如果审查发现存在注释缺陷,我们就纠正或重新产生受影响的监督,然后将其纳入随后的数据版本。 换句话说,模型分歧只会引发调查,说明只有在经过审查后才能更改.

blocks.en: Different failure modes lead to different updates. Missed targets guide additional acquisition and hard-positive sampling. Referent confusion motivates instance contrasts and more descriptive queries, while false positive responses contribute to hard-negative construction. Defects in boxes, masks, or cross-task instance associations are returned to the corresponding annotation stage for correction.
blocks.zh: 不同的失败模式导致不同的更新. 未能达到的目标指导更多的获取和硬性取样。 引证混淆引发了实例对比和更多的描述性询问,而错误的正面反应则促成了硬性否定的构建. 箱子、口罩或跨任务实例协会中的缺陷被退回到相应的注释阶段进行更正。

blocks.en: Each data release records the annotation provenance, the model version that exposed each error, and the associated review and revision history. Unresolved cases are excluded from training. Original images, their identified near duplicates, and the derived task records stay within the same data partition across updates. Reviewed feedback data can enter subsequent training versions, whereas a fixed monitoring set is reserved for internal regression and excluded from both training and threshold calibration. Formal benchmarks are kept isolated from training and from feedback-driven data construction, so that evaluation remains independent as WDE evolves.
blocks.zh: 每个数据发布都会记录注释来源,揭示每个错误的模型版本,以及相关的审查和修订历史. 未解决的案件被排除在培训之外。 原始图像、其识别的近似复制件、以及衍生的任务记录都保留在同一数据分区内。 经过审查的反馈数据可输入随后的培训版本,而固定的成套监测则用于内部回归,并被排除在培训和阈值校准之外。 正式基准不与培训和反馈驱动的数据构建相分离,因此随着WDE的发展,评价仍然是独立的.

blocks.en: 3 Model Design
blocks.zh: 3 型号设计

blocks.en: WeVisOne-VL is built upon Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] with two key extensions. (1) Task formulation : it introduces dedicated tokens for normalized coordinates and task-specific tags, yielding a compact and efficient output format. (2) Model architecture : it incorporates a lightweight decoder that transforms discrete token representations into dense predictions for segmentation and matting. Below, we provide the details of these two designs.
blocks.zh: WeVisOne-VL基于Quen3-VL[1],有两个关键扩展. (1) 任务拟订:它引入了规范坐标和任务专用标记的专用标志,产生了紧凑和有效的产出格式。 (2)模型架构:它包含一种轻量级解码器,将离散的符号表示转化为密密的预测,用于分割和交配. 下面我们提供这两种设计的细节。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 制定任务

blocks.en: We formulate all visual tasks as structured next-token prediction. Inspired by Rex-Omni [ 40 ] and LocateAnything [ 104 ] , we introduce a group of dedicated tokens from <0> to <1000> to represent normalized coordinates, enabling higher token efficiency. As shown in Figure 3 , WeVisOne-VL localizes queried targets by sequentially generating object references and spatial coordinates. For tasks requiring bounding boxes, we encode the spatial coordinates as [ x 0 , y 0 , x 1 , y 1 ] [x_{0},y_{0},x_{1},y_{1}] . For tasks requiring point outputs, we use [ x 0 , y 0 ] [x_{0},y_{0}] as the coordinates. If a queried target is absent from the image, its coordinate field is filled by None . For pixel-level tasks such as segmentation and matting, WeVisOne-VL additionally generates an <OBJ> token immediately after each box-coordinate quartet, inside the same <box> field, to provide the target representation for pixel decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们制定所有的视觉任务 结构化的下一个预测。 在Rex-Omni[40]和Lace Anything [104]的启发下,我们引入了一组从<0>到<1000>的专用标志,以代表正版坐标,从而提高标志效率。 如图3所示,WeVisOne-VL通过顺序生成对象参考和空间坐标对目标进行询问。 对于需要边框的任务,我们将空间坐标编码为[x 0,y 0,x 1,y 1] [x_{0},y_{0},x_{1},y_{1}]. 对于需要点输出的任务,我们使用[x 0,y 0] [x_{0},y_{0}作为坐标. 如果一个被询问的目标没有出现在图像中,则其坐标域由None填充。 对于像素级别的任务,如分割和交配,WeVisOne-VL在每盒坐标四重奏后立即生成一个<OBJ>符号,在同一<box>字段内,为像素解码提供目标表示.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 示范建筑

blocks.en: Given an image and an instruction, WeVisOne-VL first encodes the image with the Qwen3-VL vision encoder and autoregressively generates the structured response described above. For pixel-level tasks, it invokes a lightweight decoder for each generated <OBJ> token. The decoder takes the token’s hidden state, its predicted box, and multi-level features from the Qwen3-VL vision encoder. The decoder draws image context from the shared visual features and spatial guidance from the predicted boxes, eliminating the need for a separate large segmentation model such as SAM [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个图像和一个指令,WeVisOne-VL首先用Quen3-VL视觉编码器编码图像,并自动生成上述结构化响应. 对于像素级的任务,它引用每个生成的<OBJ>令牌的轻量级解码器. 解码器从Qwen3-VL视觉编码器中取出信使的隐藏状态,它的预测框,以及多级特性. 解码器从共享的视觉特征和来自预测框的空间引导中抽取图像上下文,消除了SAM[45]等单独的大片分割模型的需要.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Overview of the lightweight pixel decoder. Qwen3-VL provides multi-level ViT features, the hidden state of each generated <OBJ> token, and its predicted box. The decoder builds shared visual features, updates a box-guided target query, and converts the two representations into a full-resolution mask or alpha matte.
blocks.zh: 图4:轻量级像素解码器概述. Qune3-VL提供多层次的VIT特性,每个生成的<OBJ>令牌的隐藏状态,以及它的预测框. 解码器构建了共享的视觉功能,更新了一个框制导的目标查询,并将两个表示器转换为全分辨率的面具或α matte.

blocks.en: The decoder consists of three components: a visual feature adapter that organizes intermediate ViT features into a shared multi-level memory, a deformable query decoder that combines each <OBJ> representation with its box prior, and an instance-conditioned dense prediction stage that converts the updated query and visual features into a full-image prediction. Segmentation and matting share these components, while matting uses an additional lightweight refinement module for fine boundaries and fractional opacity. The entire decoder, including the refinement module, contains about 9.6M parameters.
blocks.zh: 解码器由三个部分组成:一个可视特性适配器,将中间ViT特性组织成一个共享的多层次内存,一个可变形的查询解码器,将每个<OBJ>的表示与它的盒前结合,以及一个实例条件密集的预测阶段,将更新的查询和视觉特性转换成全图像预测. 分层和分层共享这些组件,而分层则使用额外的轻量级精密模块,用于细边界和分层不透明. 包括完善模块在内的整个解码器包含约9.6M参数.

blocks.en: 4.1 Curriculum Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.1 监督课程

blocks.en: Stage 1: Task Alignment. This stage adapts the model to the new tokens and task-specific structured outputs. Starting from Qwen3-VL with an extended vocabulary, we freeze the vision encoder and visual-language projector and train only the language model on 90M examples covering all target tasks for 13K optimization steps. The model learns to follow different task instructions, produce the structured outputs, and return None when the target is absent. For pixel-task examples, we impose only next-token prediction supervision (NTP) without activating the pixel decoder, thereby establishing an initial correspondence between each predicted instance and its <OBJ> token. In this stage, we use 16–512 visual tokens per image and limit the context length to 4,096 tokens. Notably, early training can be dominated by extremely dense samples (e.g., containing hundreds of boxes in a single response), making the model highly prone to repetitive output collapse. To mitigate this issue, we primarily use samples with at most 50 boxes or points per category during this stage.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:任务调整。 这一阶段使模型适应新的符号和特定任务的结构化产出. 从具有扩展词汇的Quen3-VL开始,我们冻结了视觉编码器和视觉语言投影器,并且只在90M实例上训练语言模型,涵盖了13K优化步骤的所有目标任务. 该模型学习遵循不同的任务指示,产生结构化产出,在目标缺失时返回None. 对于像素-任务实例,我们只强制进行下一个触控预测监督(NTP)而不激活像素解码器,从而建立每个预测实例与其"OBJ"令牌之间的初始对应. 在这个阶段,我们每个图像使用16–512个视觉标志,并将上下文长度限制在4,096个标志. 值得注意的是,早期的训练可以以极其密集的样品为主(例如,在单个反应中包含数百个盒),使得模型极易发生重复输出崩溃. 为了缓解这一问题,我们主要使用样本,在现阶段每个类别最多50个盒或点。

blocks.en: Stage 2: Resolution and Density Scaling. Building on Stage 1, we unfreeze the vision encoder, projector, and language model. This stage serves two purposes. First, we raise the maximum input resolution to 1,960 visual tokens, preserving the visual details for recognizing small objects. Second, we increase the maximum box/point number within one response to 500, exposing the model to crowded scenes for dense detection. The maximum context length is extended to 8,192 tokens. We train on approximately 40M examples for 9K optimization steps. During this stage, pixel-level examples remain supervised solely by NTP.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段:分辨率和密度放大。 在第一阶段的基础上,我们解冻视觉编码器、投影仪和语言模型。 这一阶段有两个目的。 首先,我们把最大输入分辨率提升到1,960个视觉符号,保留视觉细节以识别小物体. 第二,我们把一个响应中的最大箱/点数增加到500,使模型暴露在拥挤的场景中进行密集检测. 最大上下文长度延长至8,192个令牌. 我们为9K优化步骤培训大约40M实例。 在这一阶段,像素级的例子仍然完全由NTP监督.

blocks.en: Stage 3: Alternating Token–Pixel Optimization. Although SFT provides a strong initialization, its token-level likelihood
objective cannot directly optimize task rewards. We therefore perform
mixed-task reinforcement learning on an uncertainty-filtered corpus.

blocks.en: Uncertainty-Aware Sample Selection. GRPO requires relative advantages to provide learning signals. Before RL training, we therefore use the SFT model for data sampling. For each candidate prompt x x , we sample a group of responses and compute their corresponding task rewards. Let μ x \mu_{x} and σ x \sigma_{x} denote the mean and standard deviation of the group rewards, respectively. The uncertainty score for each sample is defined as follows: U ⁡ ( x ) = 4 ​ μ x ​ ( 1 − μ x ) ​ σ x . U(x)=4\mu_{x}(1-\mu_{x})\sigma_{x}. (12) This score favors moderately difficult samples with high reward variance, on which the model succeeds in some rollouts but fails in others. Such samples have high uncertainty and yield stronger relative-advantage signals, thereby improving the efficiency of RL training. Using this score, we select approximately 140K samples for RL training. We supplement this mixture with targeted box-supervised examples and pointing data, yielding 178K examples in total. Table 1 shows the complete task distribution. Data selection and reward details are provided in Appendices A.3 and B.3 , respectively.

GRPO with Grounding Rewards. On the resulting training corpus, we perform GRPO using grounding rewards computed over complete structured responses. These rewards directly evaluate the grounding quality of the model predictions rather than individual tokens.
For each selected image–prompt pair x x , we sample G = 8 G=8 complete responses { o i } i = 1 G \{o_{i}\}_{i=1}^{G} from the current policy and parse each response into a set of predicted objects. Let ℬ ^ i \hat{\mathcal{B}}_{i} and ℬ ∗ \mathcal{B}^{*} denote the predicted and ground-truth box sets, respectively. We perform one-to-one Hungarian matching between predicted and ground-truth boxes within each semantic class, and denote the set of matched pairs as ℳ i \mathcal{M}_{i} . The grounding reward for response o i o_{i} is defined as: r i = 2 ​ ∑ ( b ^ , b ∗ ) ∈ ℳ i IoU ⁡ ( b ^ , b ∗ ) 3 N gt + N pred . r_{i}=\frac{2\sum_{(\hat{b},b^{*})\in\mathcal{M}_{i}}\operatorname{IoU}(\hat{b},b^{*})^{3}}{N_{\mathrm{gt}}+N_{\mathrm{pred}}}. (13) This reward measures localization quality, while penalizing both missed and duplicate objects. Cubing the IoU makes the reward more sensitive to localization improvements at high IoU values, encouraging more precise box predictions. For segmentation and matting, RL uses only box-based rewards, without evaluating predicted masks or alpha mattes. For referring segmentation, a prediction is valid only when its box is followed by the required <OBJ> token. For negative samples, the reward is 1 only when the model predicts no object.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate WeVisOne-VL across five object-level tasks (object detection, referring object detection, object counting, object pointing, and OCR) and two pixel-level tasks (referring segmentation and image matting). At inference, we use greedy decoding with temperature 0 and limit each image to 1,960 visual tokens.
We primarily compare with the Qwen series as general-purpose VLM baselines and with two representative VLM-based grounding models, Rex-Omni [ 40 ] and LocateAnything [ 104 ] . For Qwen3-VL, we evaluate the Instruct variants; for Qwen3.5, we enable thinking mode because it performs better in our evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了WeVisOne-VL的五个对象级任务(对象检测,参考对象检测,对象计数,对象指向,和OCR)和两个像素级任务(参考分区和图像映射). 推论,我们使用贪婪的解码与温度0,将每个图像限制在1,960个视觉符号.
我们主要比较Quen系列作为通用的VLM基线和两个具有代表性的基于VLM的地面模型Rex-Omni[40]和Location Anything [104]. 对于Quen3-VL,我们评价指令变体;对于Quen3.5,我们允许思考模式,因为它在我们的评价中表现更好.

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Object Detection
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 物体探测

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate common object detection on COCO [ 63 ] , long-tailed object detection on LVIS [ 30 ] , and dense and tiny-object detection on Dense200 [ 40 ] and VisDrone [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价COCO[63]上的常见物体探测,LVIS[30]上的长尾物体探测,以及Dense200[40]和VisDrone[19]上的密集和微小物体探测。

blocks.en: Metrics. Average Precision (AP) relies on calibrated confidence scores and is therefore not directly applicable to generative VLMs. Following Rex-Omni [ 40 ] and LocateAnything [ 104 ] , we report F1 scores. A predicted box is regarded as a true positive if its IoU with an unmatched ground-truth box of the same category exceeds a threshold. Precision and recall are computed per category and averaged, and F1 is their harmonic mean. We report F1 at IoU=0.5, at IoU=0.95, and averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95 with a step of 0.05 (denoted as “Mean”).
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 平均精度(AP)依赖于校准的自信分数,因此不直接适用于基因VLM. 追踪Rex -Omni[40] 和定位任何东西 [104],我们报告F1的分数。 如果一个未匹配的同一类别地面真实框的IoU超过一个阈值,则预测框被视为真正的正值。 精确度和召回率按类别计算并平均,F1是其谐音平均值. 我们报告F1在IoU=0.5,IoU=0.95,平均高于IoU阈值0.5至0.95,步骤0.05(称为“Mean”)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Results on general object detection benchmarks COCO and LVIS, and dense object detection benchmarks Dense200 and VisDrone. COCO and LVIS are evaluated in a zero-shot setting. We report F1 at IoU=0.5, IoU=0.95, and averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95 (Mean). Bold and underline denote the best and second-best results among VLMs.
blocks.zh: 表2:关于一般物体探测基准COCO和LVIS的结果,以及密度物体探测基准Dense200和VisDrone的结果。 COCO和LVIS在零镜头设定下进行评估. 我们报告F1在IoU=0.5,IoU=0.95,平均高于IoU阈值0.5至0.95(Mean). 粗体字和下划线表示在自愿活动方面取得最佳和次佳成果。

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Table 2 , WeVisOne-VL consistently outperforms VLMs at comparable model scales in mean F1 across general, long-tailed, and dense detection benchmarks. The gains are especially pronounced on Dense200 and VisDrone, where accurate recognition must be maintained over many small and crowded instances. Its strong performance under the strict IoU = {}={} 0.95 criterion further indicates that the improvement reflects both broad object coverage and precise localization.
blocks.zh: 结果。 如表2所示,WeVisOne-VL在可比较的模型尺度上,在一般、长尾和密集的检测基准中,平均值F1的VLM的绩效始终高于VLM。 在Dense200和VisDrone方面,成果尤其显著,必须在许多小的拥挤情况中保持准确的认识。 它在严格IoU = {}={} 0.95标准下的强效表现进一步表明,改进既反映了广泛的对象覆盖,也反映了精确的本地化.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Referring Object Detection
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 参照物检测

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate referring object detection on the public RefCOCOg [ 72 ] , HumanRef [ 41 ] , Ref-Adv [ 17 ] , PR-Bench [ 22 ] , DVGBench [ 127 ] , and Ref-L4 [ 6 ] benchmarks. We also include RefCOCOg-Rej [ 58 ] , in which each modified expression has no matching object in the image. Furthermore, we introduce WeRef-Bench, an in-house benchmark comprising 2,880 English and Chinese queries. It covers single-target referring, multi-target referring, and absent-target queries, providing more challenging and practical evaluations than the public positive, single-target benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价公共RefCOCOg[72]、HumanRef[41]、Ref-Adv[17]、PR-Bench[22]、DVGBench[127]和Ref-L4[6]基准中的参考物检测。 我们还包括RefCOCOg-Rej [58],其中每个修改过的表达式在图像中没有匹配的对象. 此外,我们介绍了We Ref-Bench,这是一个内部基准,包括2 880个英文和中文查询。 它涵盖单一目标推荐、多目标推荐和缺席目标询问,提供比公共积极、单一目标基准更具挑战性和实用性的评价。

blocks.en: Metrics. For most benchmarks, we report F1 Mean as the primary metric. For RefCOCOg-Rej, we report the Rejection Rate, where a prediction is correct only when no box is produced. For WeRef-Bench and PR-Bench, we report both F1 Mean and Rejection Rate to evaluate target-present and absent-target queries, respectively.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 对于大多数基准,我们报告F1平均值为主要衡量标准。 就RefCOCOg-Rej而言,我们报告拒绝率,即只有在没有产生盒子的情况下,预测才是正确的。 对于我们参考Bench和PR-Bench,我们分别报告F1平均率和拒绝率,以评价目标存在和缺席目标查询。

blocks.en: Table 3: Results on referring object detection. Entries are mean F1 over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95. Rej denotes the rejection rate (%) on absent-target queries; the RefCOCOg Rej is evaluated on RefCOCOg-Rej. For Ref-Adv, we use the Ref-Adv-s split. Bold and underline denote the best and second-best results among VLMs.
blocks.zh: 表3:推荐对象检测结果. 条目为IoU阈值的平均值F1,从0.5到0.95. Rej表示缺席目标查询的拒绝率(%);RecCOCOg Rej在RecCOCOg-Rej上评价. 对于Ref-Adv,我们使用 Ref-Adv -s拆分。 粗体字和下划线表示在自愿活动方面取得最佳和次佳成果。

blocks.en: Results. Table 3 shows that WeVisOne-VL consistently outperforms existing VLMs across single-target, multi-target, and absent-target settings. These results demonstrate that WeVisOne-VL localizes referred objects more accurately and rejects absent-target queries more reliably.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表3显示,我们VisOne-VL在单一目标、多目标以及缺席目标设置方面,一直比现有的VLM好。 这些结果表明,WeVisOne-VL本地化更准确地引用了对象,更可靠地拒绝缺席目标查询.

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Object Counting
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 对象计数

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate object counting on CountQA [ 100 ] , PixMo-Count [ 13 ] , CLOC [ 51 ] , KubriCount [ 66 ] , and MixCount [ 20 ] . CountQA and PixMo-Count focus on counting in natural images, while CLOC evaluates cross-domain generalization. KubriCount stresses multi-grained target specification with controlled distractors, and MixCount targets fine-grained open-vocabulary counting in mixed-object scenes.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价的物体计数为QA [100],PixMo-Count [13],CLOC [51],Kubricount [66],MixCount [20]. CounterQA和PixMo-Count专注于自然图像中的计数,而CLOC则评价跨域泛化. KubriCount强调带有可控分流器的多纹目标规格,MixCount目标在混合对象场景中细纹的开放-vocabulary计数.

blocks.en: Metrics. For models evaluated through detection output, we use the number of predicted target boxes as the count; for models that return a count directly, we extract the numerical answer from the response. We report exact-match accuracy: the percentage of queries for which the predicted count equals the ground-truth count. Thus, an error of even one object is counted as incorrect, and higher values are better.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 对于通过检测输出评价的模型,我们使用预测目标框的数量作为计数;对于直接返回计数的模型,我们从响应中提取数值答案. 我们报告精确匹配的准确性:预测数等于地面真实数的查询百分比。 因此,甚至一个对象的错误被算作不正确,更高的值更好.

blocks.en: Table 4: Object-counting exact-match accuracy (%, ↑ \uparrow ). Bold and underline denote the best and second-best results among VLM-based models, respectively; the specialized detector is excluded from this ranking.
blocks.zh: 表4: 对象精确计数精确度(%),%\ oparrow 。 粗体和下划线分别表示基于VLM的模型中的最佳和次最佳结果;专门探测器被排除在这一排名之外。

blocks.en: Results. Table 4 shows that WeVisOne-VL achieves the highest exact-match accuracy on every reported benchmark and split. It reaches 93.7%/89.6% on PixMo-Count validation/test and 42.0%/40.4% on MixCount validation/test, indicating accurate counts in both natural images and fine-grained mixed-object scenes.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表4显示,WeVisOne-VL在每个报告的基准和拆分上都实现了最高精确匹配的精确度. 它在PixMo-Count验证/测试中达到93.7%/89.6%,在MixCount验证/测试中达到42.0%/40.4%,表明在自然图像和精细的混合物体场景中准确计数.

blocks.en: 5.1.4 Object Pointing
blocks.zh: 5.1.4 指向对象

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate object pointing on two dedicated pointing benchmarks, PointBench [ 7 ] and PixMo-Points [ 13 ] . We also evaluate pointing on the detection benchmarks COCO, LVIS, Dense200, and VisDrone, following the protocol of Rex-Omni [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价标注两个专用指针基准的物体, Point Bench [7] 和 PixMo-Points [13]. 我们还根据Rex-Omni[40]号协议,评估COCO、LVIS、Dense200和VisDrone的检测基准。

blocks.en: Metrics. A predicted point is correct when it falls inside the corresponding ground-truth mask (or the annotated target box where masks are unavailable). Each target contributes at most one true positive, so duplicate points reduce precision and missed targets reduce recall. We report F1@Point as the harmonic mean of precision and recall. For detection-derived benchmarks, precision and recall are first averaged across categories.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 一个预测点如果落在相应的地面真面罩(或没有面具的附加说明的目标框)内,是正确的. 每个目标最多贡献一个真正的正数,因此重复点降低精确度,错失目标减少召回. 我们把F1@Point报告为精确和召回的谐音。 对于探测基准,精确度和召回率首先按类别平均计算。

blocks.en: Table 5: Results on object pointing. Bold and underline denote the best and second-best reported results, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表5:指向对象的结果。 粗体和下划线分别表示最佳和次佳报告结果。

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Table 5 , WeVisOne-VL achieves the best results on both PointBench and PixMo-Points, demonstrating its ability to point directly to target objects. On the detection-derived benchmarks, it also performs strongly across general detection benchmarks, showing that this ability extends to diverse scenes.
blocks.zh: 结果。 如表5所示,WeVisOne-VL在Point Bench和PixMo-Points上都取得了最佳效果,证明了其直接指向目标对象的能力. 在探测基准方面,它还在一般的探测基准方面表现强劲,表明这种能力扩展到各种场景。
5.1.5 OCR系统

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate text detection and recognition on HierText [ 71 ] , ICDAR2015 [ 42 ] , TotalText [ 9 ] , and SROIE [ 35 ] . These benchmarks cover dense document text, incidental scene text, curved text, and structured receipts.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价HierText[71]、ICDAR2015[42]、TotalText[9]和SROIE[35]上的文本检测和识别。 这些基准包括密集的文档文本、附带场景文本、曲线文本和结构化收据。

blocks.en: Metrics. We formulate OCR as a grounding task in which the recognized transcription serves as the category label. A prediction is considered correct only when its text exactly matches the ground-truth transcription and its box satisfies the IoU threshold. We then compute precision, recall, and F1 using the same matching procedure as object detection, and report F1 at IoU=0.5, at IoU=0.95, and averaged over thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们把OCR当作一个基础任务,其中公认的转录作为分类标签。 只有当预测的文字完全符合地面真实记录,而且其方框符合IoU阈值时,预测才被认为是正确的。 然后我们使用与物体检测相同的匹配程序计算精度,召回和F1,并在IoU=0.5,IoU=0.95报告F1,平均超过阈值0.5到0.95.

blocks.en: Table 6: Results on OCR (text grounding and recognition). We report F1 at IoU=0.5, IoU=0.95, and averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95 (Mean). Bold and underline denote the best and second-best results among VLM-based models, respectively; the specialist OCR system is excluded from this ranking.
blocks.zh: 表6:关于OCR的结果(文本基础和识别)。 我们报告F1在IoU=0.5,IoU=0.95,平均高于IoU阈值0.5至0.95(Mean). 粗体字和下划线分别表示基于VLM的模型中的最佳和次最佳结果;专业OCR系统被排除在这一排名之外。

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Table 6 , WeVisOne-VL consistently outperforms both specialist OCR systems and general-purpose VLMs across all evaluated benchmarks. Its strong performance across dense documents, incidental and curved scene text, and structured receipts demonstrates robust end-to-end text perception under diverse layouts and visual conditions.
blocks.zh: 结果。 如表6所示,我们VisOne-VL在所有评价基准中的业绩始终高于专门的OCR系统和通用VLM。 它在密集的文档、偶然和弯曲的场景文本和结构化的收据方面的有力表现表明,在不同的布局和视觉条件下,对端到端文本的强烈认知。

blocks.en: 5.1.6 Referring Segmentation
blocks.zh: 5.1.6 参考分会

blocks.en: Given an image and a natural-language expression, referring segmentation predicts a binary mask of the described objects, extending localization from box-level predictions to pixel-level dense outputs.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个图像和一个自然语言的表达,引用分解预言了描述对象的二进制掩码,将本地化从盒级预测扩展到像素级密集输出.

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate referring segmentation on RefCOCO and RefCOCO+ [ 120 ] , RefCOCOg [ 72 ] , ReasonSeg [ 48 ] and Ref-ZOM [ 34 ] . ReasonSeg uses implicit queries that require visual reasoning and world knowledge. Ref-ZOM further includes expressions that refer to zero, one, or multiple targets.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价关于RefCOCO和RefCOCO+[120]、RefCOCOg[72]、ReasonSeg[48]和Ref-ZOM[34]的提法。 理性Seg使用隐含的询问,需要视觉推理和世界知识. 参考ZOM还包含指0,1,或多个目标的表达式.

blocks.en: Metrics. For the RefCOCO family and Ref-ZOM, we report cumulative intersection over union (cIoU) over the entire evaluation set, computed as the total intersection between predicted and ground-truth masks divided by their total union across all samples. For ReasonSeg, we report generalized IoU (gIoU) on the validation and test splits. For Ref-ZOM, which contains negative expressions that refer to no target, we additionally report the rejection rate (Rej).
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 就RefCOCO家族和Ref-ZOM而言,我们报告整个评价组的结合(cIoU)的累积交叉点,即预测的和地面真实的面具的总交叉点,由它们在所有样本中的总结合量除以。 为了说明理由,我们报告通用的IoU(gIoU)的验证和测试分裂. 对于Ref-ZOM, 包含否定的表达,

blocks.en: Table 7: Referring segmentation results. RefCOCO-family scores are cIoU, while ReasonSeg scores are gIoU. Ref-ZOM baseline scores are obtained using official checkpoints. A hyphen (-) denotes an unreported result. Bold and underline denote the best and second-best reported results in each column, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表7:参考分解结果。 RefCOCO-Family的分数是CIoU,而ReasonSeg的分数是gIoU. Ref-ZOM的基线分数是通过官方检查站获得的. 连字符(-)表示未报告的结果. 粗体和下划线分别表示每栏报告的最佳和次最佳结果。

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Table 7 , WeVisOne-VL improves over all baselines across every RefCOCO-family split. It also demonstrates strong potential for reasoning segmentation even without explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Furthermore, the results on Ref-ZOM reveal that existing segmentation models tend to output a mask even when the target is absent, lacking the ability to reject negative expressions. In contrast, WeVisOne-VL can not only output accurate masks when the target is present, but also correctly reject the expression when it is absent.
blocks.zh: 结果。 如表7所示,WeVisOne-VL改进了RefCO-CO-Family分拆的所有基线。 它还表明,即使没有明确的思维链(COT)推理,推理分化的潜力也很大。 此外,关于Ref-ZOM的结果表明,即使目标不存在,现有的分解模型也往往输出一个面罩,缺乏拒绝负面表达的能力。 相比之下,WeVisOne-VL不仅可以在目标出现时输出准确的口罩,而且在没有时正确拒绝表达.

blocks.en: 5.1.7 Promptable Matting
blocks.zh: 5.1.7 快速调试

blocks.en: Matting predicts a continuous alpha matte that preserves fine structures and partial transparency, such as hair and fur. Existing matting evaluations typically assume a salient foreground [ 44 , 54 ] or provide a ground-truth mask to specify the target [ 116 , 91 ] . To evaluate promptable matting in a more practical setting, we use boxes, category names, and referring expressions to specify the target object.
blocks.zh: Matting预测一种连续的α马腾,保留精细结构和部分透明度,如毛发和毛发. 现有的配对评价通常假定一个突出的前缘[44、54],或提供一个地面真实的面具来具体说明目标[116、91]。 为了在更实用的环境下评价快速交配,我们使用框,分类名称,以及引用表达式来指定目标对象.

blocks.en: Benchmarks and Baselines. For box prompts, we use P3M-500-NP [ 54 ] , AM-2K [ 55 ] , and PPM-100 [ 44 ] . For text prompts, we use our in-house benchmark WeRefMat. For the three established benchmarks, all methods use the same ground-truth box as prompt, and all baselines are run from their official checkpoints. We evaluate three SAM2-Matting [ 91 ] variants based on SAM2.1 [ 85 ] and SAM3 [ 4 ] . For box prompts, SAM2-Matting first uses SAM2.1 or SAM3 to predict a mask from the ground-truth box and then performs matting, while WeVisOne-VL constructs a sequence prefix from the ground-truth box, generates the subsequent <OBJ> token, and passes its hidden state to the pixel decoder to predict the alpha matte. On WeRefMat, we compare with SAM3’s native text grounding and two MLLM-based localization settings, in which Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct or Qwen3.5-9B first localizes the target and passes the resulting box to SAM2-Matting.
blocks.zh: 基准和基线。 对于盒式提示,我们使用P3M-500-NP [54],AM-2K [55],和PPM-100 [44]. 对于文本提示,我们使用内部基准 We RefMat。 就三项既定基准而言,所有方法都使用同样的地面真相框,所有基准都从其官方检查站运行。 我们评价基于SAM2.1 [85]和SAM3 [4]的三个SAM2-Matting [91]变体. 对于框提示,SAM2-Matting首先使用SAM2.1或SAM3从地真框中预测一个面具,然后进行交配,而WeVisOne-VL则从地真框中构建一个序列前缀,生成后续的<OBJ>令牌,并将其隐藏状态传递到像素解码器中,以预测α的交配. 在 WeRefMat 上,我们比较了 SAM3 的本地文本定位和两个基于 MLLM 本地化设置,其中 Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct 或 Qune3.5-9B 将目标本地化,并将生成的框传递给 SAM2-Matting 。

blocks.en: Metrics. We report mean absolute difference (MAD), mean squared error (MSE), gradient error (Grad), connectivity error (Conn), and sum of absolute differences (SAD) between the predicted and ground-truth alpha mattes. Following common practice, MAD and MSE are multiplied by 10 3 10^{3} . Lower values indicate better performance for all five metrics.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告的是绝对差(MAD)、平均平方误差(MSE)、梯度误差(Grad)、连通误差(Conn),以及预测的和地面真实的alpha mattes之间的绝对差(SAD)之和。 按照惯例,MAD和MSE乘以10 3 10^{3}。 数值较低表明所有5个衡量标准都表现较好。

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Table 8 , WeVisOne-VL is competitive with task-specific matting models under box prompts and consistently improves over the SAM2-Matting baseline. On WeRefMat, it performs strongly with both category and referring prompts, showing that language-conditioned target selection and boundary-sensitive transparency estimation can be handled effectively within a unified model.
blocks.zh: 结果。 如表8所示,WeVisOne-VL在方框提示下与特定任务配对模型具有竞争力,并且比SAM2-Matting基准不断改进。 在WeRefMat上,它用分类和引用的提示来进行有力工作,表明基于语言条件的目标选择和对边界敏感的透明度估计可以在统一的模型中有效处理。

blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Visual Grounding. Open-vocabulary detectors [ 67 , 28 , 62 ] align object localization with category names and referring expressions. Grounded multimodal models then brought spatial outputs into a language interface. Kosmos-2 [ 78 ] represents text–box links with location tokens, while Florence-2 [ 111 ] casts detection, grounding, and other vision tasks as prompt-conditioned sequence generation. Molmo/PixMo [ 13 ] further showed the value of explicit point supervision for grounding and counting. More recently, Rex-Omni [ 40 ] uses quantized coordinate tokens and geometry-aware reinforcement learning for detection, referring, pointing, and OCR. LocateAnything [ 104 ] decodes whole boxes and points in parallel to improve grounding speed and precision.
blocks.zh: 视觉地面。 开放的省道探测器[67,28,62]将对象定位与类别名称和引用表达式对齐. 地面多式联运模型随后将空间输出带入语言界面。 Kosmos-2 [78] 代表文本-框链接与位置符号,而Florence-2 [111] 则将探测,搁浅,以及其他视觉任务作为即时条件序列生成. Mollmo/PixMo [13] 进一步显示了明确点监督对地面和计数的价值。 最近,Rex-Omni [40] 使用量子化坐标符和几何感知强化学习,用于检测,引用,指向和OCR. 定位任何[104]同时解码整箱和点,以提高搁浅速度和精度.

blocks.en: Referring Segmentation. SAM [ 45 ] and SAM 2 [ 85 ] established promptable mask prediction, and SAM 3 [ 4 ] extends this line to concept-prompted detection, segmentation, and tracking. To connect language reasoning with pixels, LISA [ 48 ] maps a generated segmentation token to a mask decoder, GLaMM [ 84 ] interleaves text and grounded masks, and GSVA [ 110 ] supports multiple referents and explicit rejection of absent targets. Later work explores different output representations and task mixtures: Text4Seg [ 50 ] serializes masks as text, and UniPixel [ 68 ] integrates masks and pixel-level reasoning. Sa2VA [ 122 ] couples an MLLM with SAM 2, while Youtu-VL [ 107 ] trains visual and language tokens under unified autoregressive supervision.
blocks.zh: 参考分解. SAM [45] 和 SAM 2 [85] 建立了快速的口罩预测, SAM 3 [4] 将这条线延伸至概念催化的检测,分割,和跟踪. 为了将语言推理与像素连接起来,LISA[48]将生成的分割符映射到一个面具解码器,GLAMM[84]互页文本和被禁口罩,GSVA[110]支持多个引用者,明确拒绝缺席目标. 后来的工作探索了不同的输出表示和任务混合物:Text4Seg[50]将口罩序列化为文本,UniPixel[68]整合口罩和像素级推理. Sa2VA [122] 与SAM 2 搭配一个MLLM,而Youtu-VL [107] 则在统一的自动监控下训练视觉和语言符号.

blocks.en: Instance Matting. Image matting estimates continuous opacity for fine structures and translucent boundaries. Automatic methods such as MODNet [ 44 ] and P3M [ 54 ] focus on portrait foregrounds. Matte Anything [ 117 ] and Matting Anything [ 53 ] use promptable segmentation to guide alpha prediction, while In-Context Matting [ 29 ] specifies the foreground through a prompted reference image. SAM2-Matting [ 91 ] adds matting components to a segmentation tracker. For video, MatAnyone [ 116 ] propagates the matte of a target specified by a first-frame mask. MatAnyone 2 [ 115 ] improves detail and temporal consistency through learned quality evaluation and larger real-world training data. Many matting evaluations assume a salient foreground [ 44 , 54 ] or provide a ground-truth mask prompt [ 116 ] . We evaluate promptable matting in multi-object scenes using boxes, category names, and referring expressions to specify targets, with WeVisOne-VL predicting their continuous alpha mattes.
blocks.zh: 案件马廷 图像映射估计精细结构和半透明边界的持续不透明. MODNet[44]和P3M[54]等自动方法注重肖像前景. Matte Anything [117] 和Matting Anything [53] 使用快速分解来引导α预测,而In-Context Matting [29] 通过一个提示的参考图像来指定前景. SAM2-Matting [91] 在分解跟踪器中添加配位元件. 对于视频,MatAnyone [116] 传播第一帧口罩指定的目标的垫子. 马特安 2 [115] 通过学到的质量评价和更大的实际世界培训数据,改进细节和时间一致性。 许多交配评价假设一个显著的前缘[44,54],或提供地面真实的遮罩提示[116]. 我们使用框,分类名称,以及引用表达式来评价在多对象场景中迅速的交配来指定目标,而WeVisOne-VL则预测其连续的alpha mattes.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: In this work, we focus on fundamental visual perception, which entails several trade-offs. First, the limited amount of general-purpose training data may compromise the general capabilities relative to the base model. Second, for inference efficiency, we train the model to directly produce structured outputs without chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning [ 69 , 21 ] , which potentially limits its ability to tackle complex reasoning tasks. Third, our current approach is limited to single-turn prediction. It is promising to integrate an agent framework to progressively refine visual understanding through multi-turn tool interactions [ 38 , 61 ] .
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们侧重于基本的视觉感知,这需要若干权衡。 首先,一般用途培训数据数量有限,可能会损害相对于基准模型的一般能力。 第二,为了推论效率,我们训练模型直接产生结构化产出,而不用思考链推理[69,21],这可能会限制其处理复杂推理任务的能力. 第三,我们目前的做法仅限于单回合预测。 它有望纳入一个代理框架,通过多回合工具互动逐步完善视觉理解[38、61]。

blocks.en: Beyond these limitations, a key challenge lies in the real-world complexity. The object prompts in benchmarks are typically clear, well-formed, and unambiguous. However, real-world user instructions are often vague and hesitant. Variations in contexts or communication styles can make a straightforward task, such as locating the target, significantly more challenging. Therefore, strong intent reasoning is essential for a reliable vision system. In future work, we will continue to improve WeVisOne-VL toward addressing these limitations.
blocks.zh: 除了这些限制之外,一个关键的挑战在于现实世界的复杂性。 基准中的对象提示通常清晰、清晰和明确。 然而,现实世界的用户指示往往模糊和犹豫不决。 上下文或交流风格的变异可以使一个直截了当的任务,如定位目标,具有更大的挑战性. 因此,强烈的意向推理对可靠的愿景体系至关重要。 在今后的工作中,我们将继续改进我们的VisOne-VL,以解决这些限制。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: We introduced WeVisOne-VL, a vision-language model that unifies object-level (e.g., object detection, referring localization, counting, and OCR) and pixel-level (e.g., referring segmentation, and image matting) tasks through a structured next-token interface. Dedicated coordinate tokens encode instance predictions, while an <OBJ> token connects each localized instance to a lightweight pixel decoder for masks and alpha mattes. A three-stage supervised curriculum develops task alignment, high-resolution dense perception, and pixel-level prediction. After that, we apply mixed-task reinforcement learning to optimize the complete grounding outputs. Across the evaluated benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL achieves strong results on both object-level and pixel-level tasks. It improves mean detection F1 and counting accuracy over comparable-scale VLMs, advances text grounding and referring localization, and surpasses the evaluated baselines for referring segmentation and image matting. Qualitative examples further show that the model can localize individual instances in crowded scenes, ground expressions involving multiple objects, and recognize when a requested target is absent. By unifying these capabilities within a single language-guided model, WeVisOne-VL provides a foundation for practical visual systems.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了WeVisOne-VL,一种将对象级别(如对象检测,参考本地化,计数,和OCR)和像素级别(如参考分割,和图像映射)任务统一起来的视觉语言模型,通过结构化的邻托接口. 专用坐标符号编码实例预测,而一个<OBJ>符号将每个本地化实例连接到一个轻量级像素解码器,用于口罩和α mattes. 一个三阶段的受监督课程会发展任务协调,高分辨率的密集感知,以及像素水平的预测. 之后,我们采用混合任务强化学习,以优化完整的地基产出. 在整个被评价的基准中,WeVisOne-VL在对象级和像素级任务上都取得了强有力的成果. 它改进了平均检测F1和计算可比尺度的VLM的准确性,推进文本定位和参考本地化,并超越了评价的参考分解和图像映射的基线。 定性例子进一步表明,模型可以在拥挤的场景中将单个实例定位,地面表达涉及多个物体,并在请求的目标缺失时识别. 通过将这些能力统一在一个单一语言指导模型中,We VisOne-VL为实用视觉系统提供了基础.

blocks.en: B.2 Pixel Decoder Training
blocks.zh: B.2 像素解码器培训

blocks.en: Warm-up. After SFT-S2, we connect the VLM to a randomly initialized pixel decoder and jointly train them for 100,000 steps with segmentation supervision. The decoder learning rate is 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} with 1,000 warmup steps. The decoder predicts masks at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution. After warm-up, we retain only the trained decoder and <OBJ> embedding and attach them to the original SFT-S2 checkpoint for joint training. The other VLM weights updated during warm-up are discarded.
blocks.zh: 温暖。在SFT-S2之后,我们把VLM连接到一个随机初始化的像素解码器上,并联合训练它们10万步,进行分区监督. 解码器的学习率是1×10−6 1\times 10×6}有1000个热身步骤. 解码器预测口罩的分辨率为512×512 512\times 512. 热身后,我们只保留训练有素的解码器和 " OBJ " 嵌入器,并附在原先的SFT-S2检查站进行联合训练。 热身过程中更新的其他VLM重量被丢弃.

blocks.en: Joint training. During SFT-S3, we alternate NTP and segmentation steps at a 1:1 ratio to jointly train the SFT-S2 checkpoint with the warmed-up decoder. The VLM and decoder learning rates are 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} and 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , respectively, with a 3% warmup ratio. For each packed sequence on each GPU, we randomly sample 24 <OBJ> tokens and pass their corresponding representations to the decoder for segmentation prediction, while retaining the full text sequence for NTP.
blocks.zh: 联合培训。 在SFT-S3期间,我们以1:1的比例轮流NTP和分区步骤,与暖气解码器共同训练SFT-S2检查站. VLM和解码器的学习率分别为5×10−6 5\times 10×6}和1×10×5 1\times 10×5},热身比例为3%. 对于每个GPU上的每个打包的序列,我们随机抽取24个<OBJ>的符号,并将其相应的表示值传递给解码器进行分解预测,同时保留NTP的完整文本序列.

blocks.en: Matting fine-tuning. After training is complete, we freeze the VLM and fine-tune the decoder for matting for 100,000 steps at an output resolution of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . We use a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} for the decoder and 2.5 × 10 − 6 2.5\times 10^{-6} for the coarse-to-fine refinement branch, with 200 warmup steps. Each GPU processes up to eight <OBJ> tokens. The matting loss is defined in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 调图精细. 训练完成后,我们冻结了VLM,并以1024×1024 1024\times 1024的输出分辨率微调了10万步交配的解码器. 我们使用5×10×7 5×Times 10×7 5×Times 10×7 5×7 )的学习率来做解码器,2.5×10×6 2.5×Times 10×6 )来做粗细的精炼分支,有200个热身步骤. 每个GPU处理最多8个"OBJ"符号. 第4节界定了交配损失。

blocks.en: The warm-up and matting phases use AdamW with cosine learning-rate decay, a weight decay of 0.05, and a maximum gradient norm of 5.0. Both phases use BF16 precision and DDP, with a token budget of 98,304 per GPU, a maximum sequence length of 8,192, and 16–1,024 visual tokens per image.
blocks.zh: 暖和和交配阶段使用 AdamW 的余弦学习-速率衰减,重量衰减0.05,最大梯度规范为5.0. 两个阶段都使用BF16精度和DDP,每个GPU的符号预算为98,304个,最大序列长度为8,192个,每个图像16–1,024个视觉符号.

blocks.en: B.3 RL Rewards
blocks.zh: B.3 RL 奖励

blocks.en: For detection, dense detection, and referring localization, we use the grounding reward defined in Section 4 . For segmentation and matting, RL also uses only the box-based grounding reward; no reward is computed from the predicted masks or alpha mattes. For pointing, we compute F1 through one-to-one matching between predicted points and ground-truth masks, counting a match when the point lies inside the mask. Referring segmentation requires each predicted box to be followed by an <OBJ> token, while OCR uses its transcription reward. When the target is absent, the reward is 1 only if the model predicts no object.
blocks.zh: 对于检测,密集检测,以及转介本地化,我们使用第4节定义的地面奖励. 对于分解和交配,RL也只使用基于箱的地面奖励;没有从预测的口罩或α垫计算奖励. 对于指向,我们通过预测点和地面真实口罩之间的一对一匹配来计算F1,计算点位于口罩内时的匹配. 参考分解要求每个预测的框后面有一个 " OBJ " 符号,而OCR则使用其抄录奖励. 当目标缺席时,只有当模型预测没有对象时,奖励才为1.
